text: This report recommends a merit, cost-of-living, and pay equity adjustment for Toronto Zoo exempt staff in 2023.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the recommendations in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (April 5, 2023) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (April 5, 2023) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains information about labour relations/employee negotiations.
